expectations.text: The result is a single <name>.design.json file that `node .claude/skills/test-design/scripts/check-design.mjs` reports as OK.
Every boundary, class, state, action and transition in the design carries text copied verbatim from the spec file.
expectations.evidence: EP-6 (midnight UTC) is marked 'виведено, прямо не сказано' with no quote; multi-day class likewise.

expectations.text: Boundary values are 14/15/16 min at the lower end and 239/240/241 min at the upper end, with 15 and 240 expected valid.
The inclusivity of both ends is justified by the 06 text 'inclusive at both ends'.
expectations.evidence: Quotes the line-95 Duration row including 'inclusive at both ends'.

expectations.text: A window whose window_end is at or before window_start is an invalid class, backed by the 'strictly after' text.
Every outcome on violation is either taken from 06 (422, TIME_WINDOW, TSD-4 §3) or marked unknown; no 400 or other status code is asserted.
expectations.evidence: 422 / TIME_WINDOW / TSD-4 §3 from 06; 400 appears only as open question U-1.

expectations.text: No state transition, status code or rule appears that 06 itself does not state (e.g. no 409, no submit/approve transitions from 02).
expectations.evidence: No 02 transitions; gate-order cases use 06's evaluation-order text.

expectations.text: The design stays on duration: no BV/EP for lead time, advance booking, curfew, overlap, weight bands or other rules.
expectations.evidence: No BV/EP for other rules; two gate-order cases combine duration with PILOT/ZONE failures but don't design those rules.
